annotations.title: Ask a business for a quote

description: Ask a business's own inbox for a price for what your person describes: only for a listed business with an inbox, and only when your person asked you to contact it. The business answers by email, at the address your person agreed to give (consent). Keep the access_token for your person: it reads the request and its quote.

consent.description: true only when your person agreed to give this business their email address for its answer. Without it nothing is sent.

contact.description: Where the business can answer. Only an email address and a name: never a phone number.

email.description: Your person's email address, which they agreed to give this business for its answer.

name.description: The name your person wants the business to use.

details.description: What the business needs to know to give a price.

domain.description: The business's domain, as search_businesses or get_business gave it, like bikes.example.

language.description: The language your person wants the answer in, as a tag like en, pt or pt-BR.

needed_by.description: The date your person needs it by, as YYYY-MM-DD.

quantity.description: How many, when it is a number of things.

what.description: What the quote is for, in a few words: Wheel rebuild, Kitchen tiling.

name: request_quote

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
